newsitem.title: UK: ARA bunkers mainly steady, quiet.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers mainly steady, quiet.

text.p: ARA bunkers were mainly steady on Thursday, with Antwerp players saying Rotterdam was setting the pace as some dealers influenced prices as they focussed on their own trading strategies.
"There wasn't much physical demand but in Rotterdam a few players were setting the price in the swaps market.
"There wasn't any physical need," said one Antwerp dealer.
In Amsterdam dealers said prices firmed on a rising barge market, with 180 cst closing $2 up from the open at $125.
A Hamburg dealer described the market there as "stable to firm."
"There have been a couple of pieces of business but it is pretty quiet," he added.
The Med was also quiet, with dealers in Fos, Augusta and Piraeus all reporting a seasonal lull.
In Algeciras one dealer said there was little if any activity with barges in dry dock. --London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
